nodes.title: FP16 convolution value classes and required crosses are covered
nodes.statement: Every required FP16 convolution value class and mode cross identified by the reviewed coverage plan has a covered or Human-waived disposition for the current revision.
nodes.purpose: Expose feature-level coverage gaps instead of treating one project-wide percentage as closure.
scope: mode, saturation, rounding, and exception crosses marked required
acceptance_criteria: Each required item has non-zero hits or an approved item-specific waiver
Coverage database and analysis report identify the current design and test revision
work_content: Implement value-class coverpoints and required crosses
Map every required coverage item to the feature matrix
implementation_approach: Use the reviewed coverage plan as the only source of required bins and crosses
Collect coverage in targeted and regression runs, then analyze the exported database
deliverables: Coverage database and item-level hole analysis report
quality_checks: No covered item has zero hits
Every exclusion carries approved Human waiver metadata
Coverage artifacts match the current revision
